PERF-01.evidence: Fixed — PERF-01 final re-measure (2026-10-01, D294; earlier close-out D291–D293). A fresh 5-run re-measure of the close-out build did not reproduce its 141 / 153 ms: home TBT median 242 ms (runs 219–314, perf 91), category 261 ms (runs 227–380, perf 93), product 146–169 ms. Over budget were the framework boot task (V8 compiling React DOM and the Next router lazily on the main thread, 125–250 ms per run) and a relayout at FCP when Public Sans latin swaps in. Fix: V8 explicit compile hints (`//# allFunctionsCalledOnLoad`) on the build's root main files (`scripts/build/compile-hints.mjs`, run by `npm run build`), which moves that compilation to the script-streaming thread. Final build on :3100, Lighthouse 13 mobile, applied throttling (budget method, D112), 5-run medians, benchmarkIndex 4034–4190: / perf 96 · a11y 100 · SEO 100 · LCP 2228 ms · TBT 88 ms (39–98); /delovi/kocioni-diskovi 98 · 100 · 100 · 1959 ms · 77 ms (42–101); /deo/kocioni-disk-prednji-276-24-mm-demo-0004 97 · 100 · 100 · 2048 ms · 47 ms (0–56). Simulated reference (3 runs): perf 86 / 87 / 88, a11y 100, SEO 100, TBT 0 ms. The other templates were last measured in the close-out, before the compile hints (which only remove main-thread work): /upit 155 ms over nine runs, the rest 54–159 ms. Evidence: docs/qa/fix/perf-gate.md („PERF-01 final re-measure“), docs/qa/fix/close/perf01-final-{devtools,simulate,hints-pass1,expect-experiment}.txt.
